message: Support ticket: a Slack message beginning "/pulse feedback" did not create feedback. Slack event log row shows the event arrived (200) with createdFeedbackId = null and text "/pulse feedback Export is slow\nIt takes 2 minutes for 10k rows". Single-line "/pulse feedback ..." messages from the same channel do create feedback.

context.source: observed by running the agent-written parser on the logged text (returns null for the two-line message, an object for the one-line one)
